artist_reel_line: The Caleb Klauder Country Band made its Mountain Stage debut in April 2012.
Nettwerk Records released After the Flood in 2004, then Smart Kid.
Their Republic of Strings debut had Laurie Lewis and Sara Watkins as guests.
No Depression put Volume One between reverent and slapstick.
They were on every Pickathon bill from 1999 to 2002.
O California!, her 25th album, came out February 13, 2026.
She was on the Pickathon bill five times, from 1999 to 2006.
Caleb Klauder lists Pig Iron among his early bands.
Country Standard Time called them one of the best unsigned bluegrass acts in the U.S.
Too Late Too Soon, recorded in Portland, came out in September 2022.
CrissCross, his 2024 album, came out in October.
